title: Importing the C++ Standard Library
description: How a C++ program reaches the standard library: preprocessor includes, using-declarations, and the C++20 module alternative.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: C++ 程式如何取得標準程式庫：前置處理器的 #include、using 宣告，以及 C++20 的模組替代方案。

questions.prompt: Which directive includes a standard header in classic C++?

prompt.zh-Hant: 在傳統 C++ 中，哪一個指示用於包含標準標頭檔？

explanation.zh-Hant: #include 由前置處理器展開，把標頭檔內容插入原始碼；#import 不是標準 C++ 指示。

questions.explanation: #include is expanded by the preprocessor, which inserts the header's contents into the source. #import is not a standard C++ directive.

questions.prompt: Which C++20 keyword imports a module instead of textually including a header?

prompt.zh-Hant: C++20 用哪一個關鍵字匯入模組，而不是以文字方式包含標頭檔？

explanation.zh-Hant: import 匯入已編譯的模組介面；include 只是前置處理器的文字插入。

questions.explanation: import brings in a compiled module interface. include is only textual insertion performed by the preprocessor.

questions.prompt: Putting `using namespace std;` at global scope in a header file is good practice.

prompt.zh-Hant: 在標頭檔的全域範圍寫 `using namespace std;` 是好習慣。

explanation.zh-Hant: 標頭會被許多檔案包含，全域 using 會把整個 std 帶進每個包含者，容易造成名稱衝突；應在 .cpp 內使用或只 using 特定名稱。

questions.explanation: A header is included by many translation units, so a global using-directive leaks all of std into every includer and invites name collisions. Prefer a using-declaration or qualify names.

prompt.zh-Hant: <iostream> 是 C++ 標準標頭檔。

explanation.zh-Hant: <iostream> 屬於標準程式庫，提供 cin、cout、cerr、clog 等串流物件。

questions.explanation: <iostream> is part of the standard library and declares cin, cout, cerr and clog.

questions.prompt: Which of these make a std name usable? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些做法可以讓 std 的名稱被使用？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: using 宣告、using 指示與完整限定名稱都可行；`include std;` 不是 C++ 語法。

questions.explanation: A using-declaration, a using-directive or a fully qualified name all work. `include std;` is not C++ syntax.

questions.prompt: Which of these are standard C++ headers? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些是 C++ 標準標頭檔？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: vector、string、algorithm 都是標準標頭；<conio.h> 是 DOS/Windows 編譯器的非標準擴充。

questions.explanation: vector, string and algorithm are standard headers. <conio.h> is a non-standard DOS/Windows extension.

questions.prompt: The directive that textually pulls a header into a translation unit begins with #____.

prompt.zh-Hant: 以文字方式把標頭檔引入編譯單元的指示，以 #____ 開頭。

explanation.zh-Hant: #include 會在編譯前把指定檔案的內容插入目前位置。

questions.explanation: #include inserts the contents of the named file before compilation begins.

questions.prompt: The namespace that contains cout, vector and string is ____.

prompt.zh-Hant: 包含 cout、vector 與 string 的命名空間是 ____。

explanation.zh-Hant: 標準程式庫的名稱都放在 std 命名空間中。

questions.explanation: All standard library names live in the std namespace.

questions.prompt: In one or two sentences, contrast `#include <vector>` with `import std;`.

prompt.zh-Hant: 用一至兩句比較 `#include <vector>` 與 `import std;`。

model.zh-Hant: #include 是前置處理器的文字插入，會把整個標頭檔內容貼進每個編譯單元；import 匯入已編譯的模組，只暴露匯出的名稱，編譯較快且較不受巨集影響。

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩者都能取得標準程式庫，但一個是文字替換，一個是語言層級的模組匯入。

answer.model: #include is a preprocessor text insertion: the whole header is pasted into every translation unit. import loads a compiled module and exposes only its exported names, which compiles faster and is less affected by macros.

questions.explanation: Both give access to the standard library, but one is textual substitution and the other is a language-level module import.

a.zh-Hant: 所有編譯器都支援的標準標頭

b.zh-Hant: GCC 提供的非標準「一次包含所有標頭」檔

explanation.zh-Hant: 它是 GCC/libstdc++ 的非標準便利標頭，方便競賽程式一次引入大量標準標頭，但不可移植且拖慢編譯。

options.text: A standard header supported by every compiler
A non-standard GCC header that includes many standard headers at once

questions.explanation: It is a non-standard GCC/libstdc++ convenience header that pulls in many standard headers. It is not portable and slows compilation.
